data.description:
## Goal

As the proxy operator, verify end-to-end (parent LP-0MUGQHPJ50046LV8) that a
watchdog release genuinely frees the llama-server slot: a stalled backend is
aborted, `/slots` polling recovers, a subsequent dispatch succeeds, and the
2026-09-25 wedged-prefill shape is covered by a regression test - all without a
proxy restart.

## Acceptance Criteria

- AC2: After a watchdog release, the slot is genuinely free at llama-server
  (integration test with a stalled fake backend observes the request aborted),
  `/slots` polling recovers and a subsequent dispatch succeeds without a proxy
  restart.
- AC4: A regression test reproduces the 2026-09-25 shape - long prefill (68k+
  token prompt), client abandoned mid-prefill, watchdog fires - and asserts
  bounded recovery, local dispatch restored, and no restart required.
- AC6: Full suite green via `/skill:test`.

## Implementation notes

- Add integration/regression tests alongside the unit tests from the dependency
  item, using a stalled fake llama-server (fake `/slots` and
  `/v1/chat/completions` endpoints) so no live backend is required.
- Assert the upstream request is aborted (stream closed / connection dropped)
  and that a following dispatch is admitted (no `local_dispatch_denied`, no
  `slots_stale`).
- Assert no `counter recovered: reset from N to 0` warning is emitted.

## Key Files

- `proxy/tests/test_watchdog_upstream_cancellation.py`
- `proxy/proxy/router.py`
- `proxy/proxy/router_helpers.py`

## Deliverables

- Stalled-backend integration test and 68k-prefill regression test.
